distinctions: A structural closure and a printed shape remain separate when their functional scenario differs; colour, material and incidental place alone do not justify separation.
Paper origami depictions are consolidated across different pictured objects.
A cityscape made of repeated houses and an interactive single house with an opening door remain separate compositions.
Different familiar animals or objects in prints denote distinct depicted visual motifs, not material or colour variants.
